scenes.text: Imagine driving deep into a Mexican desert where your radio suddenly dies, your GPS compass spins uncontrollably, and even satellites completely lose your track.

You have just entered the Mapimí Zone of Silence, a bizarre patch of land where wireless signals go to die, first discovered when a US military missile mysteriously veered hundreds of miles off course and crashed directly into its center.

Scientists later discovered the soil here is packed with ancient meteorite debris, creating a massive magnetic shield that swallows radio waves while locals report witnessing floating lights and strange humanoid figures wandering the heat haze.
Whether it is a natural magnetic glitch or a secret alien landing pad, would you ever dare to spend a night alone in this silent wasteland, and will you follow for more?
